name: Albalophosaurus
isnote: Original authors placed it in Cerapoda incertae sedis; later analyses recover it as a basal ceratopsian, a basal pachycephalosaur or another position (Han et al. 2012; Fonseca et al. 2024, in the cited Wikipedia revision).
sum: Albalophosaurus is a small ornithischian from the Barremian Kuwajima Formation of Japan with uncertain ceratopsian affinities.
wsnote: Juvenile holotype; no size given in the sources used.
holotype: SBEI 176, cranial bones of an incomplete disarticulated skull and left lower jaw of a juvenile — Kuwajima Formation, Japan.
biology: Not inferable from a juvenile skull.
author: Ohashi and Barrett 2009

sources.text: Ohashi, T. 2009. A new ornithischian dinosaur from the Lower Cretaceous Kuwajima Formation of Japan. Journal of Vertebrate Paleontology 29(3): 748–757. doi:10.1671/039.029.0306
